PM/GM at LEO Innovation LabLEO lab model
LEO Innovation Lab as an operating model		LEO Pharma could see digital disruption coming to healthcare. Its answer was an arm's-length innovation lab: better to disrupt ourselves than let a competitor do it. Keeping it separate made sense: different thinking, different ways of working, experts from all sorts of fields. A true melting pot.Build and ship ventures inside that model, and get them home to the core business.They did.
